groups.title: A-Levels (UK)
items:
GCSE/IGCSE Examinations of the approved British Examination Bodies,
with minimum 5 (Five) subjects in A, B, C, D and E grades, including English
at Ordinary 'O' Level and 2 subjects of which, one subject must be Mathematics
at Advanced 'A' Level.

groups.title: International Baccalaureate (IB)
items: 3SL, 3HL with a minimum of 24 credit points with Mathematics as a compulsory subject.

groups.title: IB Diploma Course (i.e. Certificate) Programme
items: 3SL, 3HL with a minimum of 24 credit points with Mathematics as a compulsory subject.

groups.title: IB Career Related Study Programmes
items:
Students graduating with 02 DP Subjects (1 subject must be mathematics) with at least 01 subjects
at HL level and minimum 3 points in each DP subject.
Career Related Study (CRS) with at least 03 Subjects.

International Baccalaureate Career Related Study (IBCP)
qualification with core components requirement awarded by
International Baccalaureate (IB).
